messages:
Micaela: Heads up — we have an ongoing incident (see ops thread) that overlaps with tonight's 9pm PT webinar. Need quick agreement on statuspage wording + webinar comms timing. :eyes:
Raj: Noted. Incident ID INC-2028-402. Currently partial degradation of hosted API in us-west, dedicated customers unaffected. Ops is on it.
OpsBot: Incident INC-2028-402 created by raj — severity P2. Initial detection 2026-03-21T01:05:00Z.
James: For webinar: do we delay, proceed and announce, or do a short pause? We should avoid surprises for registrants.
Micaela: Preference = proceed, add a brief announcement at the top + quick verbal note at start. If fixed before 9pm, send an update.
Sophia: Agreed. Marketing will update registration email 30m prior with a short line. Also want to coordinate statuspage copy so it's consistent across channels.
Claire: Legal asks we avoid implying root cause until confirmed. Suggest neutral language: "We are investigating reduced availability for hosted API in US-West; some customers may see increased errors or latency. Dedicated deployments and private instances are not affected."
Raj: That wording is accurate. Ops: can we confirm dedicated unaffected?
Anya: Support: we'll route inbound queries to a dedicated queue. Please add a line in the webinar chat: "If you're seeing issues, ping #support and we'll triage" — routing to the SOC triage team.
Micaela: Draft statuspage copy (proposed):
```
We are investigating reduced availability of the Redwood hosted API in the US-West region. Some customers may experience increased latency or error rates. Dedicated capacity and private deployments are not impacted. Our engineers are actively investigating; we'll post updates here and via email to affected customers.
```
Raj: Ops suggest adding ETA cadence: next update in 30 minutes.
Sophia: Marketing edits to make it shorter for the status banner: "Investigating reduced availability (US‑West). Some hosted API requests may fail or be slow. Dedicated/private deployments unaffected. Expected update: 30m."
Claire: Approved. Avoid words like "outage" until we confirm.
James: Webinar host note (script): "Heads up — we're currently monitoring a regional issue that may affect some hosted customers. Our team is on it; dedicated/private customers are not impacted. If you have questions please use the chat and we'll follow up after the session."
Micaela: Timeline/agreed actions:
- Now: publish statuspage copy (Sophia) -> set banner + incident link
- T+15m: Marketing prepares 30m-before registration banner email update (Micaela)
- T+25m: Support queue prepared + routing enabled (Anya)
- At webinar start: host reads one-line note (James)
- Post-resolution: ops will confirm and marketing will send follow-up summary to registrants
Raj: Ops will post a technical postmortem link later if root cause identified.
Anya: I will create the support queue and add canned responses for registrants. Sample canned text: "Thanks for flagging — we’re aware of a regional hosting issue; our engineers are investigating. Please include request id if available. We'll update you via status.redwood.ai and follow up."
Sophia: For inbound leads from webinar (if people ask about reliability) — routing: leads with "production" or "SLA" keywords -> sales-enterprise, others -> inbound-marketing. I'll add a one-click tag in the webinar Q&A doc.
Micaela: Good call. Can someone post a final check-in 10m before webinar start to confirm whether we should change the host script?
Raj: I'll post an ops update at T+40m.
OpsBot: INC-2028-402 updated by raj — status: Investigating -> Working. Next update scheduled in 30 minutes.
James: Thanks everyone. I'll keep the host script flexible. If things look worse, we pivot to Q&A and make the session a product update + incident Q&A.
Micaela: Perfect. I'll publish the banner now and ping the webinar channel once live. :rocket:
